daily_oracle.amount_law: monthly-region lognormal AR(1) positive weights with one exact-total normalization
daily_oracle.dtr_law: monthly-region lognormal AR(1), scaled once to the positive monthly mean target
daily_oracle.occurrence_law: monthly-region first-order Markov bridge conditional on start state and exact wet count; pooled transition probabilities bounded to [1e-6,1-1e-6] before any candidate output
daily_oracle.secondary_variables: not emitted by the climate-only research stream
daily_oracle.storm_law: not emitted by the climate-only research stream
daily_oracle.temperature_law: monthly-region Gaussian AR(1), centered and scaled once to exact zero mean and daily residual SD

architecture.joint_target_law: region-pooled 48-variable empirical Gaussian copula over log1p precipitation total, wet fraction, mean temperature, and log diurnal range; one vector per donor year

calendar.eligibility: conjunction of source_observed and finite prcp/tmax/tmin masks

reconciliation.annual_constraint: implied from the same complete candidate-fit annual rows used for monthly covariance
reconciliation.day_count_weights: normalized Gregorian month lengths for annual mean temperature
reconciliation.joint_feasibility: sample covariance of a single joint latent matrix; symmetrize; eigh; clip eigenvalues below 1e-10; renormalize diagonal to one
reconciliation.serialization: RFC 8785-style sorted compact JSON numbers emitted by Python json

generation.rng: NumPy 2.3.5 Philox with BLAKE2b-64 domain-separated seeds

wepp.reuse_rule: exact executable, scenario, climate-installation, and extraction identities required; absence fails integrated development
